name: NeRF-style Volume Rendering Integrator
definition: A simplified NeRF-style integrator that accumulates emission along a ray through a medium, backed by a dense grid instead of a neural network, with no direction-dependent emission.
summary: The NeRF-style Volume Rendering Integrator computes ray colors by accumulating emission weighted by transmittance using fixed-step marching on a dense grid, distinguishing itself by lacking direction-dependent emission and adaptive sampling.
